item.wheelofwonder.trizub.desc: A ship that is not there comes out of the fog. Its crew knows no mercy.
item.wheelofwonder.trizub.desc2: Right click an NPC: a storm, a ghost ship and its dead crew take it aboard and throw it off the stern
item.wheelofwonder.trizub.desc3: The camera keeps on the target, then follows it once taken (mouse, wheel); Ctrl - back to you
item.wheelofwonder.strange_hammer.desc: The Sorcerer Supreme steps in through a portal from another dimension.
item.wheelofwonder.strange_hammer.desc2: Right click an NPC: spikes out of the ground impale and lift it, a hammer out of a portal smashes it skywards
item.wheelofwonder.strange_hammer.desc3: The camera keeps on the target, then follows it after the blow (mouse; wheel zooms all along); Ctrl - back to you
item.wheelofwonder.telekinesis_orb.desc: Mind over matter. Not a single string - and yet it floats.
item.wheelofwonder.telekinesis_orb.desc2: Right click an NPC: a giant green hand comes down from the sky and plays with it on strings
item.wheelofwonder.telekinesis_orb.desc3: Lifts it, stretches its arms and legs, swings it round and flings it far away (about 5 s)
item.wheelofwonder.telekinesis_orb.desc4: The camera goes onto the NPC: mouse turns, wheel zooms; Ctrl - back to you
wheelofwonder.msg.tele_help: Right click - let go · wheel - nearer/farther · left button + mouse - spin · R - circle
item.wheelofwonder.ranger_ride.desc: Upside down, round and round - then into the sky with no ticket back.
item.wheelofwonder.ranger_ride.desc2: Right click: place the ride (hit it to remove)
item.wheelofwonder.ranger_ride.desc3: Numpad 7 near an NPC: seat it in the gondola (radius 30); Ctrl: camera back
item.wheelofwonder.prism_splitter.desc: The rails end in mid-air. The crystals take it from there.
item.wheelofwonder.prism_splitter.desc2: Right click: place the ride (hit it to remove)
item.wheelofwonder.prism_splitter.desc3: Numpad 7 near an NPC: seat it in the cart (radius 30); Ctrl: camera back
item.wheelofwonder.shockwave.desc: One strike, and the ground splits to the horizon.
item.wheelofwonder.shockwave.desc2: Right click: slam the spear into the ground - a rift runs where you look, pulls NPCs into a vortex and blasts them apart
item.wheelofwonder.shockwave.desc3: The camera follows the wave and the NPC it hits (mouse and wheel); Ctrl - back to you
item.wheelofwonder.chaos_meteor.desc: The sky burns. The ground shakes. You are next.
item.wheelofwonder.chaos_meteor.desc2: Right click: call a burning meteor down where you look; it rolls on, throwing every NPC in its way into the air
item.wheelofwonder.chaos_meteor.desc3: The camera follows the meteor, then the first NPC it hits (mouse and wheel); Ctrl - back to you
item.wheelofwonder.sinister_chain.desc: Hellfire chains of the Dark Carnival. Whoever wears them joins the parade.
item.wheelofwonder.sinister_chain.desc2: Right click an NPC: chain it (by a hand or a leg - where you aim); the next NPC is chained to the one before
item.wheelofwonder.sinister_chain.desc3: Everyone in a chain follows the first one, even as a ragdoll. Each NPC can be chained once
item.wheelofwonder.sinister_chain.desc4: Right click the air: start a new chain; Shift + right click an NPC: remove its chain; Shift + right click the air: remove all your chains
item.wheelofwonder.sinister_chain.desc5: Alt + right click: Whirlwind Whip - swing every chained NPC round you and let go, the chains snap; Ctrl - camera back
wheelofwonder.msg.whirl_none: No NPC on your chains nearby (standing, not a ragdoll)
wheelofwonder.msg.chain_leader: The leader is chained. The next NPCs will follow it
wheelofwonder.msg.chain_closed: Chain closed: the next NPC starts a new one
item.wheelofwonder.wheel_of_wonder.desc: Roll it, watch it float, watch them come...
item.wheelofwonder.wheel_of_wonder.desc2: Right click: send the wheel to the block you look at
item.wheelofwonder.walrus_punch.desc: Uppercut them to the sky, then meet them there.
item.wheelofwonder.walrus_punch.desc2: Left click an NPC: signature combo (normal punches while on cooldown)
item.wheelofwonder.dark_ballista.desc: A one-way ticket. No safety bar.
item.wheelofwonder.dark_ballista.desc2: Right click: place a ballista (hit it to remove)
item.wheelofwonder.dark_ballista.desc3: Numpad 7 near an NPC: load it into a ballista nearby; Ctrl: camera back
wheelofwonder.msg.no_ballista: No free ballista (radius %s) or rocket ride (radius %s) near the NPC
item.wheelofwonder.rocket_ride.desc: One lap of honour, then a one-way trip.
item.wheelofwonder.rocket_ride.desc2: Right click: place the ride (hit it to remove)
item.wheelofwonder.rocket_ride.desc3: Numpad 7 near an NPC: seat it in a rocket (radius 30); Ctrl: camera back
wheelofwonder.msg.no_npc: Walk up to an NPC or look at it
item.wheelofwonder.impalement_arts.desc: Six blades of the Dark Carnival. None of them misses.
item.wheelofwonder.impalement_arts.desc2: Right click: throw the daggers at the NPC you aim at (up to 70 blocks)
item.wheelofwonder.impalement_arts.desc3: They stay in the ragdoll; Ctrl - camera back, Shift - cancel the wind-up
wheelofwonder.msg.no_target: No NPC in that direction (up to %s blocks, no walls in between)
wheelofwonder.msg.npc_ragdoll: This NPC is a ragdoll right now: stand it up (/unragdoll) or wait a second
wheelofwonder.msg.npc_busy: This NPC cannot be loaded (too far away or already busy)
